nodes.title: SG-4.1.3 · Replace Phaser 4-only APIs with 3.90 equivalents in the Phaser modules
nodes.body:
Context: package.json pins phaser ~3.90.0. The files game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts, config.ts, createGame.ts, events.ts and game/frontend/src/components/PhaserHost.tsx were read. They use Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT, Phaser.Scale.CENTER_BOTH, render.pixelArt/roundPixels/antialias, Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN, game.scale.refresh() and game.destroy(true). All of these exist in 3.90. No Phaser 4-only API was found. Desired behavior: the audit is recorded as the code stays on 3.90-only APIs, and mocked unit tests fail if a Phaser 4-only API is introduced. Why: Phaser is pinned to 3.90 and Phaser 4-only APIs would break at runtime.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the five files, when they are scanned, then none references a Phaser 4-only API such as Phaser.Renderer.WebGL.Renderer.Filters, Phaser.GameObjects.Filters or the setFilter/enableFilters family.
- Given buildGameConfig with a mocked phaser module, when called, then it returns the 3.90 config shape (type AUTO, 640x360, pixelArt, roundPixels, FIT scaling).
- Given BootScene and PhaserHost with phaser mocked, when mounted and unmounted, then only 3.90 methods are called (events.once, scale.refresh, destroy(true)) and the scene unsubscribes on shutdown.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/createGame.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/components/PhaserHost.tsx
- Out of scope: Upgrading Phaser
- Out of scope: Changing the package.json or lockfile pin
- Out of scope: Adding new scenes
- Preserve: Typed event bus contract
- Preserve: Single Phaser instance per host
- Preserve: Pixel-art render settings


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays at ~3.90.0
- Tests use vitest with phaser mocked and no browser


## Definition of done
- Each requirement has Act and Verify units completed
- All new unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · config.ts, createGame.ts and events.ts use only Phaser 3.90 APIs
nodes.body:
Context: config.ts builds GameConfig with Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT and render options. createGame.ts calls new Phaser.Game. events.ts has no Phaser dependency. Desired behavior: these modules use 3.90 equivalents only and state the 3.90 target. Expected result: no Phaser 4-only symbol appears in them. Why: protects the 3.90 pin.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given buildGameConfig, when called with a parent element and scenes, then it returns type Phaser.AUTO, width 640, height 360 and render.pixelArt true.
- Given createGame, when called with phaser mocked, then new Phaser.Game receives the config from buildGameConfig.
- Given events.ts, when its imports are read, then it imports nothing from phaser.


## Scope
- In scope: config.ts
- In scope: createGame.ts
- In scope: events.ts
- Out of scope: BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: PhaserHost.tsx
- Preserve: GAME_WIDTH and GAME_HEIGHT exports
- Preserve: computeZoom behavior
- Preserve: createGame signature


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0


## Definition of done
- Modules carry a 3.90 target comment and use only 3.90 APIs


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene.ts and PhaserHost.tsx use only Phaser 3.90 APIs
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene uses Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN and this.events.once; PhaserHost uses game.scale.refresh() and game.destroy(true). Desired behavior: these remain 3.90 APIs, documented, and covered by mocked tests. Why: guards the lifecycle on the pinned version.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create with phaser mocked, when SHUTDOWN is emitted, then the store subscription is removed.
- Given PhaserHost mounted and unmounted with createGame mocked, then scale.refresh is called on resize and destroy(true) is called once on unmount.
- Given the two source files, when scanned, then no Phaser 4-only API is referenced.


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts
- In scope: PhaserHost.tsx
- Out of scope: config.ts
- Out of scope: New scenes
- Preserve: sceneReady emission
- Preserve: Single instance per host


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0


## Definition of done
- Comments added and tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Document the 3.90 API targets in config.ts and createGame.ts
nodes.body:

## Acceptance criteria
- Given config.ts, when read, then a comment states that Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT and render.pixelArt are the 3.90 APIs in use.
- Given createGame.ts, when read, then it still returns new Phaser.Game(buildGameConfig(parent, scenes)).

- Code path: `game/frontend/src/phaser/createGame.ts`

nodes.title: Verify: BootScene and PhaserHost 3.90 lifecycle unit tests
nodes.body:
Write tests/phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx with phaser and createGame mocked. Assert BootScene shutdown unsubscribes, PhaserHost calls scale.refresh and destroy(true), and the sources contain no Phaser 4-only API.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create run with a fake events emitter, when SHUTDOWN fires, then the zustand unsubscribe is called.
- Given PhaserHost rendered with createGame mocked returning {scale:{refresh},destroy}, when unmounted, then destroy is called once with true.
- Given a mocked ResizeObserver callback, when invoked, then scale.refresh is called.
- Given BootScene.ts and PhaserHost.tsx source, when scanned, then no Phaser 4 filter API matches.


## Scope
- In scope: tests/phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx
- Out of scope: Browser rendering
- Preserve: Existing tests


## Technical constraints
- phaser, createGame and ResizeObserver mocked


## Definition of done
- New test file passes


## Clarifying questions
- None
